An unofficial 2026 update of **MouseWrite 2.6.8b** (Steve Cochard / Roger Wagner Publishing) for the 128K Apple IIe, IIc and IIgs.

### What's new
* **File → Export ODT**: saves the open document (unsaved changes included) as an OpenDocument Text file next to it, for LibreOffice and OpenOffice. Paragraphs, page breaks, footnotes, bold, underline, super/subscript, narrow/wide, the extra styles and all six colours are kept.
* **Runs from any hard-disk folder**: Desk Accessories, the Speller and the default Open/Save folder work from wherever the `MOUSEWRITE` folder is, and fix themselves if it moves.
* **New double hi-res title screen** (*V: 3.0 · Updated by 6502 Retro 2026*). The old text title box is gone.
* *Version 3.0* throughout; the mouse tutorial, the custom-font glossary and the personal dictionaries all work from the hard disk.
* `tools/mw2odt.py` converts MouseWrite documents to `.odt` on a PC.

### How to get it
This release contains **only the new work** (source, build script, tools and docs), not MouseWrite itself, which is still copyrighted. Download the source below, put your own image of the MouseWrite 2.6.8b 800K disk in `originals/`, and run:

```sh
python3 build.py                                   # makes out/MouseWrite_3.0_Folder.hdv
python3 build.py --install-into A2DeskTop.hdv      # or installs into a copy of your hard disk
```

Python 3.8+ is all you need. The build checks every original file it changes and refuses to run on a different release. See the [README](https://github.com/6502retro/MouseWrite#readme) for details.
